title: Holiday Ad Photos and Videos for Gift Season | AIVideosUGC
description: Make holiday ad photos and videos from one product photo. Type dates, prices, or offers in the editor, then reuse the scene when those details change.
h1: Create Holiday Ad Photos and Videos Fast
lead: Holiday ad photos and videos can go up before the ship-by date is set. An avatar can hold the gift, and you type the date when the carrier confirms it.

faq.q: How do credits work for a holiday photo or video?
faq.a: A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits, Pro is $35 with 300, and Premium is $63 with 600. You see the cost before the job runs, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Can I add holiday music and seasonal visuals?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a track from the music library, add seasonal pictures, and put captions on in the editor. Use a track you are allowed to play.

faq.q: Can I make holiday scenes for many products at once?
faq.a: Yes. Run several product links in a batch, and each one comes back as its own gift scene. You still check every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can an AI avatar deliver the gift message?
faq.a: Yes. An AI avatar from the library of 53 can read a short gift note beside the product. Keep the product easy to recognize.

faq.q: What happens to the ad after the holiday ends?
faq.a: You keep the file you downloaded. Change the date, the voice, or the offer in the editor, and use the scene again for the next holiday.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Open the product page and use that photo as the gift in the scene. If the page photo is too tight, upload a clear shot you already sell with.

faq.q: Can I publish my holiday video to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file, or send it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook yourself. You still choose the budget in that ad account.

faq.q: Can I create holiday ads through an API?
faq.a: Yes. Your tools can ask for a holiday ad from a product link through the API. You approve the file before anyone else sees it.

reviews.h2: How Shops Build Gift Guide Product Images
reviews.lead: Three ways a shop gets the gift scene up before the cutoff is confirmed.

items.t: Have an actor lift the set
items.d: They paste the gift-set page and ask an actor to lift it from the box. The order-by date is typed later, so a new date can keep the same scene.

items.t: Stand a generated actor by the coat
items.d: They keep the coat's color and shape, with an actor next to an open gift. That actor is generated, not a hired customer.

items.t: Keep the candle, change the voice
items.d: They download the candle-and-ribbon scene once. Next weekend they only change the language of the voice and the offer line.

trust.h2: Yours Until the Ad Goes Live
trust.lead: Six facts you can count on before a seasonal ad goes out.

items.d: The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark, so a holiday ad can run as a paid placement. Each app still has its own rules.
You see photo and video credits on screen before you commit, so a holiday push stays on budget. A failed job returns those credits.
If a job fails, those credits return to the balance on their own. You can run the gift scene again.
The product photo and the finished gift scene stay in your account. Nothing goes public until you choose to share it.

items.t: An AI Avatar or Your Clip
items.d: Use an AI avatar from the library of 53. Or build one from a short clip of yourself.
A voice, captions, and a track from the music library can sit on the clip. Edit them in place before the ad goes live.
